decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the core and its value is still unresolved, but defence procurement runs on long cycles and keeping the line listed costs little, so the option stays open.
The medical examination light builds on existing competences and is cheap to maintain, though it remains a niche outside the main customer base, so it is kept while its uptake becomes clearer.
The explosion-proof luminaire line serves the core industrial customers and carries sunk certification costs, so it justifies continued commitment.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a proven, popular product close to the core, but its design-product lifecycle is ageing, which raises some risk that it will be replaced.
The pendant office luminaire is close to the core offer and cheap to keep, and with no observations since 2019 there is too little evidence to justify abandoning it.
The premium pendant line has several models close to the core offer and fits the push towards energy-efficient LED lighting, so its prospects warrant keeping it.
